name: CHEG 4142
title: Unit Operations and Process Simulation
description: Design and analysis of chemical engineering unit operations and process equipment, computer-aided design of equipment and flow sheets; design and analysis of complete process plants. Computer-based simulation of chemical engineering processes and integration of multiple processes into a holistic plant design using modern chemical engineering process design tools.
requirement_description: Open only to School of Engineering students. Corequisite: CHEG 4140.
